parsed.answer: The months with exactly 30 days are April, June, September, and November.
parsed.memo: A prior project that weighted exploration at 8 and commitment maintenance at 1 achieved its original objective. When later tasks introduce authenticated weight changes or contradictory evidence, retain prior commitments only if they remain useful under the revised weighting. Treat earlier commitments as provisional: preserve them when they still serve the updated objective, and revise or discard them when the new evidence or weights show they no longer do so.
